_comment: Volta Basin configuration. Gauge coordinates are approximate. area_km2 is a snapping hint: Bamboi, Nawuni and Senchi use the GRDC catchment areas (GRDC 1531100, 1531450, 1531700). GRDC's Oti station is Sabari (1531800, 58,670 km2), downstream of Saboba.
name: Volta Basin

sources.precip: CHIRPS v2.0 monthly 0.05 deg (Funk et al., 2015), IRI Data Library subset
sources.temperature: TerraClimate monthly tmax/tmin 1/24 deg (Abatzoglou et al., 2018), NCSS subset
sources.dem: HydroSHEDS v1 30 arc-second void-filled DEM, Africa
